title: Ijwi riturutse ku nkengero z'Umujyi
intro: Mu mujyi wateye umugongo ubuyobozi bw'Imana, umuntu umwe rukumbi yavuye mu nkengero z'umujyi, yirukana ubutumwa bw'ibyiringiro n'umuburo. Uyu bugingo bwibagiranye bwazaba ikimenyetso cy'ukwizera gukomeye iteka ryose.
clues: Nabonye intumwa zoherezwa mu mujyi wanjye, ariko abaturage banjye bazibona nk'abantu basanzwe.
Nizeraga ubutumwa bwabo kandi numva ukuri kunkora ku mutima.
Nasabye abantu banjye kumvira intumwa zitasabye ibihembo.
Narirutse mva ku mpera y'umujyi, ngerageza kubabwira impamvu zumvikana.
Abantu banjye barampagurukiye, ndapfa, ariko nabonye amahoro ahoraho.
Allah yarambwiye ati: 'Injira muri Paradizo,' kandi nifuzaga ko abantu banjye bazabona icyubahiro nahawe.
